program.section_heading: Inclusive and Accessible Digital Content Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to create and modify a variety of accessible documents including spreadsheets, presentations, .pdfs, flyers, and forms using accessibility checkers.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use accessibility practices to create and send accessible and readable online communications and information.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to create and modify video, audio, and web content to comply with current accessibility standards.

blocks.name: Complete the following number of credits: 36

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space ('EDUCB60NC', 'EDUCB61NC'). They are recorded with the closed list's spacing as EDUC B60NC and EDUC B61NC.
The catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours (36 hours)'. The award is recorded in hours: 18 hours per course and 36 hours total. A stray '0' under the Unit(s) header was not used.
Completion requires a grade of 'P' in the required courses.
The careers are taken from 'may increase employability in office settings, e-commerce, education, and online-based industries'. These are fields of employment, not job titles.
